description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to deterministic or theme-based colors, primarily used for visualizations in dashboards. It includes functions for generating consistent pastel colors from strings and mapping common status labels to theme colors, ensuring high contrast on dark backgrounds.

methods.name: colorFromString
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color string from an input string, producing distinct hues for different strings while maintaining consistent saturation and lightness for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor
methods.description: Maps a given status string to a theme color (primary, success, error, etc.) based on predefined mappings; falls back to a deterministic color if the status is unknown.
